hooks.name: task-needs-requirement
hooks.description: Before a spec task starts, make the agent tie it to requirement IDs and property tests (agent action: costs credits, cannot block).

action.prompt: Before you write code for this task: (1) name the requirement IDs from this spec's requirements.md that it satisfies; (2) name the fast-check properties or example tests that cover each one, and the test file they live in or will live in; (3) if the task maps to no requirement, stop and say so instead of coding. Keep the answer to a few lines, then continue.

hooks.name: log-task
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, append a dated row to docs/KIRO_LOG.md (scripts/kiro-log.mjs). Never fails the task.
